messages:
maria.g: Taking over for the evening shift now. Quick status: embed-service read latency elevated (P95 ~300ms), KV-cache fallback turned on for /v1/embeds, and I'm doing a rolling restart of embed pods. Job-runner queue had a short spike but scaled to 4 replicas and is draining.

lee: Thanks — do we know the root cause for the embed latency? any error spikes in the model workers?

maria.g: No obvious OOMs. Saw increased CPU on the embed inference nodes and a few `kworker` throttles in dmesg. Also noticed higher cold-KV misses for some heavy routes.

tim.o: I pushed a short-lived patch to reduce batch size for the worst-offending model variant (v2b-quant). That cut tail latency in my local repro. Rolling to prod now?

maria.g: Go for it. I've restarted two pods and left autoscaler to catch up. If patch stabilizes, we can rollback the KV fallback.

pri: FYI, alerting page shows alert `embed_read_high_p95` firing since 20:02. I muted the noisy pager for 10m while we investigate.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 - Elevated embed read latency. Severity: S2. Pager: pri. Link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-045

maria.g: Mitigations done so far:
- Enabled KV-cache fallback for heavy client routes (/api/cc/*)
- Scaled job-runner to 4 replicas
- Rolling restart of embed-deploy (2/5 pods restarted)
- Deployed temporary batch-size override for v2b-quant (canary on 10% traffic)

lee: Anything blocking you from finishing restarts or further scaling?

maria.g: Need approval to bump embed node pool by +2 GPUs (cost >$X/hr). If the canary looks good in 10m we can avoid that.

tim.o: Canary metrics look better after ~6m: P95 down from 320ms -> 190ms for canary. CPU still elevated but within limits.

pri: Added notes to INC-2026-045 with screenshots and alerts. If latency drops under 220ms for 15m we can close the incident and revert KV fallback in a controlled way.

maria.g: Plan for next shift:
- Monitor canary for 20m. If stable, roll patch to 50% then 100%.
- If P95 remains >250ms after full rollout, request scale-up of embed pool (+2 nodes).
- Prepare rollback plan: revert batch-size change and re-enable KV reads (we'll do this after 30m stable).

lee: Sounds good. I can handle the scale-up request if needed. Also will follow up with infra team about the kworker throttles.

maria.g: Thanks, tagging @lee. Leaving handoff at 19:36. Passing on current oncall checklist: monitoring links, inc ticket, and the small canary run id: canary-emb-177950.

tim.o: :thumbsup: ping me if you need a quick rollback.

pri: Noted. I'll keep the pager unmuted in 5m.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 updated: status -> monitoring. Assigned: pri, lee.

maria.g: Outgoing notes for whoever takes over: watch the canary `canary-emb-177950`, check `embed_read_high_p95` alert, and confirm KV fallback toggle state at /ops/kv-toggle. If you need to escalate, contact @lee and @tim.o. Good luck!
